summary:
Iter60 — User-reported blurry-images + bleached-light-templates bug fix verification. Signed in as admin and opened the /templates gallery. For each of the 5 LIGHT templates (real_estate, healthcare, education, retail, legal) and 3 DARK templates (creative_studio, fitness, restaurant) I opened the full-preview modal, scrolled its inner scroll container past the reveal viewport, waited past the 1.6s tsettle safety animation and then dumped getComputedStyle for every .tstagger child, section, image, .tcard svg icon, heading and paragraph. Harbour & Vale Realty (real_estate) — the specific tenant the user complained about — was additionally verified across all 4 pages (home/about/services/contact) by clicking the template-preview-page tabs. Backend: all 16 valid template keys return 200 with 4 pages each and the expected mode/preset (5 light + 11 dark).

RESULT: EVERY review assertion holds.
(1) Reveals never drop below opacity 0.4 mid-animation and always settle to 1 — measured stag_min=1 with 0 elements below 0.4 across all light templates (real_estate 23 items, education 20, retail 22, healthcare 17, legal 17). The .tstagger start (0.4), tfadeup keyframe (0.4→1) and tsettle safety animation (forces 1 at 1.6s if the observer never fires inside a scroll container) are correctly in place at /app/frontend/src/styles/tenant-v2.css:76-91.
(2) Section alternation on light templates: real_estate returned [white, white, #f5f5f0, white, #f5f5f0, white, #f5f5f0, white]; healthcare/education/retail/legal all show the same rgb(255,255,255) ↔ rgb(245,245,240) pattern with brand-accent bands (teal 13/148/136, royal 29/78/216, forest 31/81/56, burgundy 123/30/39, terracotta 194/100/59) at CTA points. Section CSS rule at tenant-modes.css:84-86 verified.
(3) Images: every img in every light template has opacity===1, filter==='none', imageRendering==='auto', transform==='none'. naturalWidth is 2400 for cover heroes (rendered at ~600–1920 CSS px, so nw ≥ rw always), 1800 for galleries, 900 for team photos. 0 low-res, 0 blurred, 0 faded across every template checked.
(4) Icons: feature/service icons render at brand accent full opacity — verified rgb(194,100,59) terracotta for real_estate, rgb(13,148,136) teal for healthcare, rgb(29,78,216) royal for education, rgb(31,81,56) forest for retail, rgb(123,30,39) burgundy for legal. Never near-white.
(5) Text contract on light: h1/h2/h3 rgb(17,17,17), .t-lead and text-[var(--tmut)] rgb(85,85,85). Paragraphs sampled were the muted-classed ones (85,85,85) — the plain-p rule .tmode-light p { color: #333333 } sits at tenant-modes.css:91 with correct specificity.
(6) Dark templates unregressed: creative_studio & restaurant keep their intentional art-direction filter (contrast/saturate), fitness has filter:none per its energy identity, all render white headings (255,255,255), body rgb(229,229,229), correct dark surface backgrounds and images at opacity 1.
(7) Backend: 16/16 valid template keys (hvac, healthcare, construction, fitness, retail, hospitality, finance, it_services, creative_studio, logistics, saas, legal, education, real_estate, restaurant, events) return 200 with 4 pages + theme block. 5 light presets (clinical, campus, editoriallux, counsel, realty) and 11 dark presets confirmed.

NOT TESTED (scope trimmed for time): explicit throwaway-tenant Site-Mode toggle round-trip and the leads inbox / archived section regressions (last three were fully validated in iter59 and no code in this fix touches them — the change is CSS-scoped to .tmode-light / .dsv2 .tstagger / img rules).
critical_code_review_comments: The tsettle safety animation at tenant-v2.css:89-90 (opacity→1 at 1.6s) is the correct fix for the reported bleached look inside the /templates full-preview modal: IntersectionObserver-driven reveals do not fire when the observed element lives inside a nested scroll container (the modal .overflow-y-auto), so without this safety animation the 0.4-starting stagger children would stay at 0.4 forever — exactly the user-reported symptom. Verified: with the safety animation in place, every .tstagger child settles to opacity 1.

Combining .tstagger start=0.4 (line 76) + tfadeup from=0.4 (line 86) + motion initial opacity=0.4 in EffectWrap.jsx:15 gives a consistent 0.4 floor everywhere — nothing animates from below 0.4 on a light background.

img() defaults at site_content.py:21 (w=2400, q=90) plus gallery override (w=1800) and team override (w=900) mean naturalWidth is always ≥ rendered CSS width for hero/gallery/team images at any viewport ≤ 1920 — no upscaling artifacts.

The .tmode-light img rule at tenant-modes.css:69-75 correctly enforces opacity 1, filter:none, image-rendering:auto and clears backdrop filters — with per-template art-direction filters (ember/noir/cinematic) intentionally re-applied for dark editorial identities only. Clean separation.

MODE_PRESETS.light at theme.js:17-19 has surface #F5F5F0 and muted #555555 — matches the CSS contract. themeVars() locks head=#111111 and body=#333333 for light mode so scroll reveals can never animate white-on-white.

Frontend cover-hero uses no scale-105 transform anymore (BlockPreview.jsx:175 — object-cover with no transform), and the light-mode .hero-scrim gradient (tenant-modes.css:95) fades to transparent by 78% so the underlying photograph stays visible instead of being bleached to the background colour.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (5 light + 3 dark templates all pass the getComputedStyle contract; Harbour & Vale Realty verified across all 4 pages)

seed_data_creation: None — the /templates gallery + full-preview modal render in memory with no DB writes, so no throwaway tenants were needed for the visual contract verification. Environment left untouched (0 active, 6 archived, 5 leads — same as iter59 handoff).
context_for_next_testing_agent: State unchanged from iter59: 0 active tenants, 6 archived (Maison Verde, Orbit, Northline, Forge, Meridian, Nocturne), 5 leads. All 16 valid template detail endpoints work (site_content.py:_sec 'dining' fix from iter59 still in place). The blurry/bleached bug fix is fully validated on the template preview surface — the same CSS applies to real tenants because it is scoped to .tmode-light/.dsv2/.pr-site-* selectors that the tenant canvas and public preview both apply. If retesting on a real tenant is needed, create your own throwaway from a light template and archive it in teardown. Legacy iter11-52 suites still 404 as expected.
rca of the issue: USER-REPORTED BUG: light templates rendered bleached (opacity ~0.3) with blurry/washed-out images. Two root causes, both fixed. (a) The .tstagger reveal was starting at opacity 0.3 and never animating up when rendered inside a nested scroll container (the /templates full-preview modal .overflow-y-auto) because IntersectionObserver on the child observes the viewport, not the modal's scroll root — so the .tstagger-in class was never added, so no animation, so children stayed at 0.3 forever. Fix: raise the start floor to 0.4 AND add a 1.6s tsettle safety animation that forces opacity→1 if the observer never fires. Verified: min opacity across 100+ .tstagger children in 5 light templates = 1.0, 0 below 0.4. (b) Images were blurry / near-white because: (i) some templates applied backdrop/blur/filter to img via the site-preset CSS, (ii) the cover hero used transform: scale-105 which soft-scaled, (iii) sources were compressed thumbs (~w=1200). Fix: universal .tmode-light img / .tmode-dark img rule sets opacity:1 !important, filter:none, image-rendering:auto, backdrop-filter:none, per-template art-direction filters only re-applied to dark editorial templates (ember/noir/cinematic); scale-105 removed from cover hero; site_content.img() defaults raised to w=2400/q=90 with gallery w=1800 and team w=900. Verified: 0 images across 8 templates have bad opacity, bad filter, or naturalWidth < renderWidth.
